errors.evidence: The chart displays one indicator (labor productivity) for four different regions. Referring to them as 'four different indicators' is imprecise.
The labels on the X-axis (the years) are horizontal, not slanted as described.
The description of the Y-axis is truncated and incomplete. It mentions the label and scale type but cuts off before stating the range (0 to 140,000) and tick intervals.

The description is truncated and entirely omits any mention of the four data series (Bulgaria, World, EC (28), USA), their corresponding colors, their trends, or their values, which constitute the main information conveyed by the chart.
